sloka: राक्षसाः सिद्धसन्नाहास्ततस्ते चण्डविक्रमाः ।तदा ऽदह्यन्त मे पुच्छं निघ्नन्तः काष्ठमुष्टिभिः ।बद्धस्य बहुभिः पाशैर्यन्त्रितस्य च राक्षसैः ।। ५.५८.१५१ ।।।।
transliteration: rākṣasāḥ siddhasannāhāstataste caṇḍavikramāḥ ।tadā 'dahyanta me pucchaṁ nighnantaḥ kāṣṭhamuṣṭibhiḥ ।baddhasya bahubhiḥ pāśairyantritasya ca rākṣasaiḥ ।। 5.58.151 ।।।।

translations.english: "Many ferociously courageous demons got ready. They bound me and hit me with firesticks and fists. They fastened my tail with ropes and set in on fire.
